def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Separators are complete rows/columns whose cells share one color.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Keep only separator lines whose color occurs as a full line; all other
    # lines form the repeated panels.
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_spans = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(row_bounds, row_bounds[1:]) if b > a + 1]
    col_spans = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(col_bounds, col_bounds[1:]) if b > a + 1]
    if not row_spans or not col_spans:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    # Choose the panel containing the most non-background cells as the source.
    panels = [(r0, r1, c0, c1) for r0, r1 in row_spans for c0, c1 in col_spans]
    sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1 = max(panels, key=lambda p: sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(p[0], p[1]) for c in range(p[2], p[3])))
    tile = [row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1 in row_spans:
        for c0, c1 in col_spans:
            for dr, r in enumerate(range(r0, r1)):
                for dc, c in enumerate(range(c0, c1)):
                    out[r][c] = tile[dr % len(tile)][dc % len(tile[0])]
    return out

new='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    # Solid lines of a non-background color divide the grid into repeated tiles.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != bg]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    rb = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_spans = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(rb, rb[1:]) if b > a + 1]
    col_spans = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(cb, cb[1:]) if b > a + 1]
    if not row_spans or not col_spans:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    panels = [(r0, r1, c0, c1) for r0, r1 in row_spans for c0, c1 in col_spans]
    src = max(panels, key=lambda p: sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(p[0], p[1]) for c in range(p[2], p[3])))
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = src
    tile = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for a, b in row_spans:
        for x, y in col_spans:
            for rr in range(a, b):
                for cc in range(x, y):
                    out[rr][cc] = tile[(rr - a) % len(tile)][(cc - x) % len(tile[0])]
    return out
